scenario.en: Sunday morning. No plans, no schedule.
scenario.id: Minggu pagi. Gak ada acara apa-apa.

answers.en: I already prepped activity ideas last night ✨
answers.id: Aku udah nyiapin ide aktivitas dr semalam ✨

answers.en: We'll see — I follow the mood of the morning 🍃
answers.id: Lihat nanti aja — ikutin mood pagi ini 🍃

scenario.en: Packing for a family day out.
scenario.id: Mau pergi seharian sekeluarga. Soal packing…

answers.en: Full checklist: spare outfit, snacks sorted by the hour, all covered
answers.id: Checklist lengkap: baju ganti, snack per jam, semua aman

answers.en: Grab the essentials — we'll figure out the rest on the way
answers.id: Bawa yg penting-penting aja, sisanya pikirin di jalan

answers.en: Nap, meals, play — roughly the same time every day
answers.id: Tidur, makan, main — jamnya kurang lebih sama tiap hari

answers.en: We follow the child's rhythm — every day can be different
answers.id: Ngikutin ritme anak — tiap hari bisa beda

answers.en: I pick and set up something good for their development
answers.id: Aku yg pilih & siapkan sesuatu yg bagus buat perkembangannya

answers.en: I lay out a few options and see what pulls them in
answers.id: Aku gelar beberapa pilihan, lihat dia tertarik yg mana

scenario.en: Your kid wants to wear a superhero costume + rain boots to a family lunch.
scenario.id: Anak mau pakai kostum superhero + sepatu boots ke acara keluarga.

answers.en: Cute — but for events like this, I choose the outfit
answers.id: Lucu sih, tp utk acara begini aku yg tentuin bajunya

answers.en: Go for it — it's their fashion era 😎
answers.id: Boleh dong — ini era fashion dia 😎

answers.en: Clear rule: playtime ends = toys go back
answers.id: Aturannya jelas: selesai main = mainan balik ke tempatnya

answers.en: I make cleanup inviting and let the habit grow from their lead
answers.id: Aku bikin beres-beres jadi menarik, pelan-pelan jd kebiasaan dia

scenario.en: Meltdown at the mall. (Yes, that one.)

answers.en: I crouch down and name it: "You're really upset, huh…"
answers.id: Aku jongkok, sebut perasaannya: "Kamu kesel ya…"

answers.en: Scoop up, hug, change of scenery, offer water
answers.id: Gendong, peluk, ganti suasana, tawarin minum

scenario.en: Their block tower collapses and they burst into tears.
scenario.id: Menara baloknya roboh, dia nangis kencang.

answers.en: "That's so frustrating — you worked hard on it." Talk first
answers.id: "Sebel banget ya, padahal udah nyusun lama." Ngobrol dulu

answers.en: "Let's build it again together" — hands already moving
answers.id: "Yuk bangun lagi bareng" — tangan langsung gerak

scenario.en: Bedtime. Your kid seems a little sad.

answers.en: I ask gentle questions about their day and let the feelings out
answers.id: Aku tanya pelan-pelan tentang harinya, biarin perasaannya keluar

answers.en: Extra-long cuddle, favorite blanket, warm milk
answers.id: Peluk ekstra lama, selimut favorit, susu hangat

scenario.en: At the playground, they eye the taller slide.
scenario.id: Di playground, dia ngelirik perosotan yg tinggi.

answers.en: "Try it! I'm right here." I spot them up close
answers.id: "Coba aja! Aku di sini." Aku jagain dr dekat

answers.en: "Maybe next time" — I steer them to the lower one first
answers.id: "Nanti dulu ya" — arahkan ke yg lebih rendah dulu

scenario.id: Habis hujan, ada genangan di mana-mana.

answers.en: Jump in! Clothes can be washed 😄
answers.id: Nyebur! Baju bisa dicuci 😄

answers.en: We go around — dry socks are happiness
answers.id: Muter dikit — kaos kaki kering itu kebahagiaan

scenario.en: Meeting new kids at a party.
scenario.id: Ketemu anak-anak baru di sebuah acara.

answers.en: I give a gentle push: "Go say hi — I'm watching from here"
answers.id: Aku dorong halus: "Kenalan yuk, aku lihatin dr sini"

answers.en: They can stay on my lap until they're ready — no rush
answers.id: Biarin dia nempel dulu sm aku sampai siap — gak buru-buru
